ID: RM-DOC-0105
Title: Harrowgate throughput collapses after canal closure
Source: Northern Business Daily
Published: 2025-03-06
Type: news_report
Event: EVT-A
Country: Brenmark
Sector: electronics; automotive
Tier: 2

Container throughput at Harrowgate has collapsed by 40 percent since the canal closure, according to figures seen by Northern Business Daily.

Port officials declined to comment. Freight forwarders described long queues at the rail terminal.
